005package org.wpilib.units;
006
007import java.util.Locale;
008
009/** Contains a set of predefined units. */
010public final class Units {
011  private Units() {
012    // Prevent instantiation
013  }
014
015  // Pseudo-classes describing the more common units of measure.
016
017  // Unitless
018  /** A dimensionless unit that performs no scaling whatsoever. */
019  public static final DimensionlessUnit Value = BaseUnits.Value;
020
021  /**
022   * A dimensionless unit equal to to 1/100th of a {@link #Value}. A measurement of {@code
023   * Percent.of(42)} would be equivalent to {@code Value.of(0.42)}.
024   */
025  public static final DimensionlessUnit Percent =
026      derive(Value).splitInto(100).named("Percent").symbol("%").make();
027
028  // DistanceUnit
029  /** The base unit of distance. */
030  public static final DistanceUnit Meters = BaseUnits.DistanceUnit;
031
032  /** The base unit of distance. */
033  public static final DistanceUnit Meter = Meters; // alias
034
035  /** 1/1000 of a {@link #Meter}. */
036  public static final DistanceUnit Millimeters = Milli(Meters, "Millimeter", "mm");
037
038  /** 1/1000 of a {@link #Meter}. */
039  public static final DistanceUnit Millimeter = Millimeters; // alias
040
041  /** 1/100 of a {@link #Meter}. */
042  public static final DistanceUnit Centimeters =
043      derive(Meters).splitInto(100).named("Centimeter").symbol("cm").make();
044
045  /** 1/100 of a {@link #Meter}. */
046  public static final DistanceUnit Centimeter = Centimeters; // alias
047
048  /** 25.4/1000 of a {@link #Meter} and 1/12 of a {@link #Foot}. */
049  public static final DistanceUnit Inches =
050      derive(Millimeters).aggregate(25.4).named("Inch").symbol("in").make();
051
052  /** 25.4/1000 of a {@link #Meter} and 1/12 of a {@link #Foot}. */
053  public static final DistanceUnit Inch = Inches; // alias
054
055  /** 304.8/1000 of a {@link #Meter}, or 12 {@link #Inches}. */
056  public static final DistanceUnit Feet =
057      derive(Inches).aggregate(12).named("Foot").symbol("ft").make();
058
059  /** 304.8/1000 of a {@link #Meter}, or 12 {@link #Inches}. */
060  public static final DistanceUnit Foot = Feet; // alias
061
062  // TimeUnit
063  /** The base unit of time. */
064  public static final TimeUnit Seconds = BaseUnits.TimeUnit;
065
066  /** Alias for {@link #Seconds} to make combined unit definitions read more smoothly. */
067  public static final TimeUnit Second = Seconds; // singularized alias
068
069  /** 1/1000 of a {@link #Seconds Second}. */
070  public static final TimeUnit Milliseconds = Milli(Seconds);
071
072  /** Alias for {@link #Milliseconds} to make combined unit definitions read more smoothly. */
073  public static final TimeUnit Millisecond = Milliseconds; // singularized alias
074
075  /** 1/1,000,000 of a {@link #Seconds Second}. */
076  public static final TimeUnit Microseconds = Micro(Seconds);
077
078  /** Alias for {@link #Microseconds} to make combined unit definitions read more smoothly. */
079  public static final TimeUnit Microsecond = Microseconds; // singularized alias
080
081  /** 1/1,000,000,000 of a {@link #Seconds Second}. */
082  public static final TimeUnit Nanoseconds =
083      derive(Seconds).splitInto(1_000_000_000).named("Nanosecond").symbol("ns").make();
084
085  /** Alias for {@link #Nanoseconds} to make combined unit definitions read more smoothly. */
086  public static final TimeUnit Nanosecond = Nanoseconds; // singularized alias
087
088  /** 60 {@link #Seconds}. */
089  public static final TimeUnit Minutes =
090      derive(Seconds).aggregate(60).named("Minute").symbol("min").make();
091
092  /** Alias for {@link #Minutes} to make combined unit definitions read more smoothly. */
093  public static final TimeUnit Minute = Minutes; // singularized alias
094
095  // AngleUnit
096  /**
097   * The standard SI unit of angle, represented by the distance that the radius of a unit circle can
098   * wrap around its circumference.
099   */
100  public static final AngleUnit Radians = BaseUnits.AngleUnit;
101
102  /**
103   * The standard SI unit of angle, represented by the distance that the radius of a unit circle can
104   * wrap around its circumference.
105   */
106  public static final AngleUnit Radian = Radians; // alias
107
108  /**
109   * A single turn of an object around an external axis. Numerically equivalent to {@link
110   * #Rotations}, but may be semantically more expressive in certain scenarios.
111   */
112  public static final AngleUnit Revolutions =
113      derive(Radians).aggregate(2 * Math.PI).named("Revolution").symbol("R").make();
114
115  /**
116   * A single turn of an object around an external axis. Numerically equivalent to a {@link
117   * #Rotation}, but may be semantically more expressive in certain scenarios.
118   */
119  public static final AngleUnit Revolution = Revolutions; // alias
120
121  /**
122   * A single turn of an object around an internal axis. Numerically equivalent to {@link
123   * #Revolutions}, but may be semantically more expressive in certain scenarios.
124   */
125  public static final AngleUnit Rotations =
126      derive(Revolutions).named("Rotation").symbol("R").make();
127
128  /**
129   * A single turn of an object around an internal axis. Numerically equivalent to a {@link
130   * #Revolution}, but may be semantically more expressive in certain scenarios.
131   */
132  public static final AngleUnit Rotation = Rotations; // alias
133
134  /** 1/360 of a turn around a circle, or 1/57.3 {@link #Radians}. */
135  public static final AngleUnit Degrees =
136      derive(Revolutions).splitInto(360).named("Degree").symbol("°").make();
137
138  /** 1/360 of a turn around a circle, or 1/57.3 {@link #Radians}. */
139  public static final AngleUnit Degree = Degrees; // alias
140
141  // VelocityUnit
142  /**
143   * The standard SI unit of linear velocity, equivalent to travelling at a rate of one {@link
144   * #Meters Meter} per {@link #Second}.
145   */
146  public static final LinearVelocityUnit MetersPerSecond = Meters.per(Second);
147
148  /**
149   * A unit of linear velocity equivalent to travelling at a rate one {@link #Feet Foot} per {@link
150   * #Second}.
151   */
152  public static final LinearVelocityUnit FeetPerSecond = Feet.per(Second);
153
154  /**
155   * A unit of linear velocity equivalent to travelling at a rate of one {@link #Inches Inch} per
156   * {@link #Second}.
157   */
158  public static final LinearVelocityUnit InchesPerSecond = Inches.per(Second);
159
160  /**
161   * A unit of angular velocity equivalent to spinning at a rate of one {@link #Revolutions
162   * Revolution} per {@link #Second}.
163   */
164  public static final AngularVelocityUnit RevolutionsPerSecond = Revolutions.per(Second);
165
166  /**
167   * A unit of angular velocity equivalent to spinning at a rate of one {@link #Rotations Rotation}
168   * per {@link #Second}.
169   */
170  public static final AngularVelocityUnit RotationsPerSecond = Rotations.per(Second);
171
172  /**
173   * A unit of angular velocity equivalent to spinning at a rate of one {@link #Rotations Rotation}
174   * per {@link #Minute}. Motor spec sheets often list maximum velocities in terms of RPM.
175   */
176  public static final AngularVelocityUnit RotationsPerMinute = Rotations.per(Minute);
177
178  /**
179   * A unit of angular velocity equivalent to spinning at a rate of one {@link #Rotations Rotation}
180   * per {@link #Minute}. Motor spec sheets often list maximum speeds in terms of RPM.
181   */
182  public static final AngularVelocityUnit RPM = RotationsPerMinute; // alias
183
184  /**
185   * The standard SI unit of angular velocity, equivalent to spinning at a rate of one {@link
186   * #Radians Radian} per {@link #Second}.
187   */
188  public static final AngularVelocityUnit RadiansPerSecond = Radians.per(Second);
189
190  /**
191   * A unit of angular velocity equivalent to spinning at a rate of one {@link #Degrees Degree} per
192   * {@link #Second}.
193   */
194  public static final AngularVelocityUnit DegreesPerSecond = Degrees.per(Second);
195
196  /**
197   * The standard SI unit of frequency, equivalent to a periodic signal repeating once every {@link
198   * #Second}.
199   */
200  public static final FrequencyUnit Hertz =
201      derive(Value.per(Second)).named("Hertz").symbol("hz").make();
202
203  /** 1/1000th of a {@link #Hertz}. */
204  public static final FrequencyUnit Millihertz = Milli(Hertz);
205
206  // Acceleration
207  /**
208   * The standard SI unit of linear acceleration, equivalent to accelerating at a rate of one {@link
209   * #Meters Meter} per {@link #Second} every second.
210   */
211  public static final LinearAccelerationUnit MetersPerSecondPerSecond = MetersPerSecond.per(Second);
212
213  /**
214   * A unit of linear acceleration equivalent to accelerating at a rate of one {@link #Foot Foot}
215   * per {@link #Second} every second.
216   */
217  public static final LinearAccelerationUnit FeetPerSecondPerSecond = FeetPerSecond.per(Second);
218
219  /**
220   * A unit of linear acceleration equivalent to accelerating at a rate of one {@link #Inch Inch}
221   * per {@link #Second} every second.
222   */
223  public static final LinearAccelerationUnit InchesPerSecondPerSecond = InchesPerSecond.per(Second);
224
225  /**
226   * A unit of angular acceleration equivalent to accelerating at a rate of one {@link #Rotations
227   * Rotation} per {@link #Second} every second.
228   */
229  public static final AngularAccelerationUnit RotationsPerSecondPerSecond =
230      RotationsPerSecond.per(Second);
231
232  /**
233   * The standard SI unit of angular acceleration, equivalent to accelerating at a rate of one
234   * {@link #Radians Radian} per {@link #Second} every second.
235   */
236  public static final AngularAccelerationUnit RadiansPerSecondPerSecond =
237      RadiansPerSecond.per(Second);
238
239  /**
240   * A unit of angular acceleration equivalent to accelerating at a rate of one {@link #Degrees
241   * Degree} per {@link #Second} every second.
242   */
243  public static final AngularAccelerationUnit DegreesPerSecondPerSecond =
244      DegreesPerSecond.per(Second);
245
246  /**
247   * A unit of acceleration equivalent to the pull of gravity on an object at sea level on Earth.
248   */
249  public static final LinearAccelerationUnit Gs =
250      derive(MetersPerSecondPerSecond).aggregate(9.80665).named("G").symbol("G").make();
251
252  // MassUnit
253  /** The standard SI unit of mass. */
254  public static final MassUnit Kilograms = BaseUnits.MassUnit;
255
256  /** The standard SI unit of mass. */
257  public static final MassUnit Kilogram = Kilograms; // alias
258
259  /** 1/1000 of a {@link #Kilogram}. */
260  public static final MassUnit Grams = Milli(Kilograms, "Gram", "g");
261
262  /** 1/1000 of a {@link #Kilogram}. */
263  public static final MassUnit Gram = Grams; // alias
264
265  /**
266   * A unit of mass equivalent to approximately 453 {@link #Grams}. This is <i>not</i> equivalent to
267   * pounds-force, which is the amount of force required to accelerate an object with one pound of
268   * mass at a rate of one {@link #Gs G}.
269   *
270   * @see #PoundsForce
271   */
272  public static final MassUnit Pounds =
273      derive(Grams).aggregate(453.592).named("Pound").symbol("lb.").make();
274
275  /**
276   * A unit of mass equivalent to approximately 453 {@link #Grams}. This is <i>not</i> equivalent to
277   * pounds-force, which is the amount of force required to accelerate an object with one pound of
278   * mass at a rate of one {@link #Gs G}.
279   *
280   * @see #PoundForce
281   */
282  public static final MassUnit Pound = Pounds; // alias
283
284  /** 1/16 of a {@link #Pound}. */
285  public static final MassUnit Ounces =
286      derive(Pounds).splitInto(16).named("Ounce").symbol("oz.").make();
287
288  /** 1/16 of a {@link #Pound}. */
289  public static final MassUnit Ounce = Ounces; // alias
290
291  // Force
292
293  /**
294   * The standard unit of force, equivalent to accelerating a mass of one {@link #Kilogram} at a
295   * rate of one {@link #MetersPerSecondPerSecond meter per second per second}.
296   */
297  public static final ForceUnit Newtons =
298      derive(Kilograms.mult(MetersPerSecondPerSecond)).named("Newton").symbol("N").make();
299
300  /**
301   * The standard unit of force, equivalent to the standard force of gravity applied to a one {@link
302   * #Kilogram} mass.
303   */
304  public static final ForceUnit Newton = Newtons;
305
306  /**
307   * The standard Imperial unit of force, equivalent to the standard force of gravity applied to a
308   * one {@link #Pound} mass.
309   */
310  public static final ForceUnit PoundsForce =
311      derive(Pounds.mult(Gs)).named("Pound-force").symbol("lbsf.").make();
312
313  /**
314   * The standard Imperial unit of force, equivalent to the standard force of gravity applied to a
315   * one {@link #Pound} mass.
316   */
317  public static final ForceUnit PoundForce = PoundsForce;
318
319  /**
320   * 1/16th of {@link #PoundsForce}, equivalent to the standard force of gravity applied to a one
321   * {@link #Ounce} mass.
322   */
323  public static final ForceUnit OuncesForce =
324      derive(Ounces.mult(Gs)).named("Ounce-force").symbol("ozf").make();
325
326  /**
327   * 1/16th of {@link #PoundsForce}, equivalent to the standard force of gravity applied to a one
328   * {@link #Ounce} mass.
329   */
330  public static final ForceUnit OunceForce = OuncesForce;
331

333
334  /** The standard SI unit for torque. */

337  /** The standard SI unit for torque. */

362  public static final TorqueUnit PoundInch = PoundInches;

374  public static final TorqueUnit OunceInch = OunceInches;

524  // TemperatureUnit
525  /**
526   * The base unit of temperature, where a value of 0 corresponds with absolutely zero energy in the
527   * measured system. Not particularly useful for robots unless you're cooling motors with liquid

529   */
530  public static final TemperatureUnit Kelvin = BaseUnits.TemperatureUnit;
531
532  /**
533   * The standard SI unit of temperature, where a value of 0 roughly corresponds to the freezing
534   * point of water and a value of 100 corresponds to the boiling point. Electronics tend to exhibit
535   * degraded performance or damage above 90 degrees Celsius.
536   */
537  public static final TemperatureUnit Celsius =
538      derive(Kelvin).offset(+273.15).named("Celsius").symbol("°C").make();
539
540  /**
541   * The base imperial (American) unit of temperature, where a value of 32 roughly corresponds to
542   * the freezing point of water and a value of 212 corresponds to the boiling point.
543   */
544  public static final TemperatureUnit Fahrenheit =
545      derive(Celsius)
546          .mappingInputRange(0, 100)
547          .toOutputRange(32, 212)
548          .named("Fahrenheit")
549          .symbol("°F")
550          .make();

582  /**
583   * Creates a unit equal to a thousandth of the base unit, eg Milliseconds = Milli(Units.Seconds).
584   *
585   * @param <U> the type of the unit
586   * @param baseUnit the unit being derived from. This does not have to be the base unit of measure
587   * @param name the name of the new derived unit
588   * @param symbol the symbol of the new derived unit
589   * @return the milli-unit
590   */
591  @SuppressWarnings("checkstyle:methodname")
592  public static <U extends Unit> U Milli(U baseUnit, String name, String symbol) {
593    return derive(baseUnit).splitInto(1000).named(name).symbol(symbol).make();
594  }
595
596  /**
597   * Creates a unit equal to a thousandth of the base unit, eg Milliseconds = Milli(Units.Seconds).
598   *
599   * @param <U> the type of the unit
600   * @param baseUnit the unit being derived from. This does not have to be the base unit of measure
601   * @return the milli-unit
602   */
603  @SuppressWarnings("checkstyle:methodname")
604  public static <U extends Unit> U Milli(U baseUnit) {
605    return Milli(
606        baseUnit, "Milli" + baseUnit.name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), "m" + baseUnit.symbol());
607  }
608
609  /**
610   * Creates a unit equal to a millionth of the base unit, eg {@code Microseconds =
611   * Micro(Units.Seconds, "Microseconds", 'us")}.
612   *
613   * @param <U> the type of the unit
614   * @param baseUnit the unit being derived from. This does not have to be the base unit of measure
615   * @param name the name of the new derived unit
616   * @param symbol the symbol of the new derived unit
617   * @return the micro-unit
618   */
619  @SuppressWarnings("checkstyle:methodname")
620  public static <U extends Unit> U Micro(U baseUnit, String name, String symbol) {
621    return derive(baseUnit).splitInto(1_000_000).named(name).symbol(symbol).make();
622  }
623
624  /**
625   * Creates a unit equal to a millionth of the base unit, eg Microseconds = Micro(Units.Seconds).
626   *
627   * @param <U> the type of the unit
628   * @param baseUnit the unit being derived from. This does not have to be the base unit of measure
629   * @return the micro-unit
630   */
631  @SuppressWarnings("checkstyle:methodname")
632  public static <U extends Unit> U Micro(U baseUnit) {
633    return Micro(
634        baseUnit, "Micro" + baseUnit.name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), "u" + baseUnit.symbol());
635  }
636
637  /**
638   * Creates a unit equal to a thousand of the base unit, eg Kilograms = Kilo(Units.Grams).
639   *
640   * @param <U> the type of the unit
641   * @param baseUnit the unit being derived from. This does not have to be the base unit of measure
642   * @param name the name of the new derived unit
643   * @param symbol the symbol of the new derived unit
644   * @return the kilo-unit
645   */
646  @SuppressWarnings("checkstyle:methodname")
647  public static <U extends Unit> U Kilo(U baseUnit, String name, String symbol) {
648    return derive(baseUnit).aggregate(1000).named(name).symbol(symbol).make();
649  }
650
651  /**
652   * Creates a unit equal to a thousand of the base unit, eg Kilograms = Kilo(Units.Grams).
653   *
654   * @param <U> the type of the unit
655   * @param baseUnit the unit being derived from. This does not have to be the base unit of measure
656   * @return the kilo-unit
657   */
658  @SuppressWarnings("checkstyle:methodname")
659  public static <U extends Unit> U Kilo(U baseUnit) {
660    return Kilo(
661        baseUnit, "Kilo" + baseUnit.name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), "K" + baseUnit.symbol());
662  }
663
664  /**
665   * Creates a new unit builder object based on a given input unit. The builder can be used to
666   * fluently describe a new unit in terms of its relation to the base unit.
667   *
668   * @param unit the base unit from which to derive a new unit
669   * @param <U> the dimension of the unit to derive
670   * @return a builder object
671   */
672  public static <U extends Unit> UnitBuilder<U> derive(U unit) {
673    return new UnitBuilder<>(unit);
674  }
